title.narrative: Jordan Quality Infrastructure Single-Donor Trust Fund

description.narrative: The overall goal of the Project is to improve competitiveness of Jordanian producers at international markets and thus increase Jordanian export.This will be done by improvement of the access of Jordanian producers to essential NQI services, support of the international recognition of the state control, and reduction of the cost of private sector compliance with national regulations by implementation of best production and regulatory practices and standards by both the public and private sector
